items.title: Widerspruch (objection) against the benefit decision
items.quote: Den Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung richten Sie innerhalb eines Monats ab ihrer Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an die Agentur für Arbeit Beispielkirchen, Agenturplatz 3, 45879 Beispielkirchen.
items.computation: Bescheid is dated 05.12.2024 (Thursday) and is sent by ordinary letter; per the letter's own clause and the standard 3-day fiction of delivery (analogous to § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), the notice counts as given on the 3rd day after posting. Counting from 05.12.2024 (day 0): day 1 = 06.12. (Fri), day 2 = 07.12. (Sat), day 3 = 08.12. (Sun). Since the 3rd day falls on a Sunday, the deemed Bekanntgabe shifts to the next business day, Monday 09.12.2024. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs from this Bekanntgabe under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of the event (09.12.2024) is excluded and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 09.01.2025 (Thursday). This date is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

items.title: Start of unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) entitlement
items.quote: auf Ihren Antrag vom 18.11.2024 bewilligen wir Ihnen Arbeitslosengeld ab dem 01.01.2025 für 360 Kalendertage.
items.computation: The decision states the benefit award begins on the calendar date explicitly given in the letter, 01.01.2025; no counting is required.

items.title: Report any change in circumstances immediately (e.g. starting work, illness)
items.quote: Bitte melden Sie uns jede Änderung sofort, zum Beispiel eine Arbeitsaufnahme oder eine Erkrankung.
items.computation: This is an open-ended, recurring duty to notify the Agentur für Arbeit 'sofort' (immediately) whenever a relevant change occurs; the letter gives no fixed calendar date or period, so no single due date can be computed — it applies continuously for as long as benefits are received.
